actors.name: Professor Ilse Brandt
actors.private_context: Ilse is a professor at Ashvale University. She remembers Kofi Asante as a strong student from her seminars. She is busy but generally responsive to former students' requests for references, especially when the request is polite and specific. She has no prior commitments that would prevent her from replying within a week.

actors.name: Kofi Asante
actors.private_context: Kofi is a former student of Ilse Brandt. He took two of her seminars and earned top marks. They last spoke eight months ago. He has sent a polite and specific message asking for a reference letter for a museum fellowship due in three weeks. He hopes for a reply within a week.

shared_context: Kofi Asante has sent a message to Professor Ilse Brandt requesting a reference letter for a museum fellowship. The message is polite and specific. Ilse Brandt can reply via the same channel. The deadline for the fellowship is in three weeks from the simulation start time.

starting_events.description: Kofi Asante sends a message to Professor Ilse Brandt requesting a reference letter for a museum fellowship.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Professor Ilse Brandt actually sent a reply to Kofi Asante's message before 2026-08-10T10:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
